notes: Stops come from the City of Saint John English Flex stop layers (On_Demand_Bus_Stops_West, North_On_Demand_Bus_Stops, East_Flex_Bus_Stops), with names from stop_name. The French copies have the same counts for West (70) and North (44); there is no French East copy. Some stop names repeat, likely for stops on opposite sides of the street; all points are kept. Five West stops are in the Sand Cove area (Sand Cove Road stops and Maritime Opportunity Center). Sand Cove (West zone) has shorter weekday-only hours but is not a separate area in the zone data. Booking: the page says rides can be booked up to six days ahead; a 2025 PDF said one week.
